proposed.text: What NBC form is used to apply for a change of occupancy under PD 1096?

options.text: NBC Form No. B-1 (Building Permit Application), typically used for new constructions
NBC Form No. B-5 (Fencing Permit), which is unrelated to occupancy changes
NBC Form No. B-12 (Application for Change of Use or Occupancy)
NBC Form No. B-7 (Demolition Permit), applicable when structures are to be removed

proposed.rationale: Mnemonic: 'B-12 for Change' — the form number B-12 corresponds to the number of letters in 'change of use' if you count creatively (or simply: B-12 is the Change of Use form). Option A (B-1) is the most common distractor — it is the new construction permit application, not the change-of-use form.
